title: 3 Days in Sajek Valley: Kingdom of Clouds & Peaks
subtitle: Wake up floating above an ocean of clouds, trek Konglak Peak & savor Bamboo Chicken
bestSeason: September to February (or July-August for dramatic rain clouds)

days.title: Khagrachari Arrival, Chander Gari Convoy & Sunset at Helipad

schedule.activity: Arrive at Khagrachari by night coach. Fresh up and savor authentic Pahari breakfast (Paratha, Dal, and organic hill papaya).
Board your reserved 4x4 open-roof Chander Gari at Dighinala. Report at the Bangladesh Army Checkpoint for the morning security escort convoy.
En-route stop at Hajachora Waterfall. Take photos and enjoy the refreshing mist.
Reach Sajek Valley crest. Check into your wooden hill cottage (e.g., Meghpunji, Madol, or Sajek Resort). Soak in the breathtaking 180-degree mountain view.
Lunch: Savor traditional Bamboo Chicken and indigenous fragrant Pahari rice at a Lusai homestyle cafe.
Walk up to Sajek Helipad for the golden sunset. Watch rolling clouds engulf the deep green valleys in purple and gold light.
Campfire or cottage balcony BBQ under a blanket of crystal-clear stars. Stargazing session.

days.title: Sunrise Cloud Sea, Konglak Peak Trek & Indigenous Village Tour

schedule.activity: Early wakeup! Step onto your balcony to witness the famous Sajek 'Ocean of Clouds' billowing below your feet as dawn breaks.
Trek up to Konglak Peak (highest peak in Sajek at 1,800+ ft). Pass through traditional Lusai and Tripura ethnic village settlements.
Enjoy fresh, chilled Pahari sweet orange and pineapple slices hand-cut by local hill villagers.
Traditional indigenous lunch: Fresh hill vegetables, wild mountain herb dal, and spicy smoked fish paste.
Explore Ruilui Para village. Visit the historic stone church and interact respectfully with local artisans crafting bamboo baskets.
Dinner featuring clay-pot slow-cooked mountain mutton with aromatic whole spices.

days.title: Alutila Mysterious Cave, Tareng & Return to Dhaka

schedule.activity: Breakfast and checkout. Join the morning 10:00 AM military return convoy down the hills.
Lunch in Khagrachari Sadar town at the famed 'System Restaurant' (authentic Chakma delicacies: Haba, Sabarang, and Bamboo shoot fry).
Adventure through the dark, water-carved limestone tunnel of Alutila Cave holding lit bamboo torches (Mashal).
Visit Tareng Park & the Hanging Bridge of Khagrachari (Horticulture Eco Park).
Board your return overnight coach to Dhaka.

packingChecklist: National ID (NID) or Passport copies for army checkpoint registration
Power bank (hill electricity can be intermittent during storms)
Warm shawl or fleece jacket (evenings and early mornings are chilly)
Sturdy walking shoes with rubber grip for Konglak Peak
Sufficient cash (ATMs in Sajek are limited/unreliable)
Mosquito repellent cream (Odomos) & personal medical kit

title: 4 Days in Sylhet & Sreemangal: Tea Gardens, Rainforest & Swamp
subtitle: Discover emerald tea trails, hear wild Gibbons call in Lawachara, and canoe through submerged mangrove trees
bestSeason: October to March (for pleasant tea garden walks) or July-August (for swollen swamp water)

days.title: Scenic Train to Sreemangal, Tea Estates & Nilkantha 7-Layer Tea

schedule.activity: Board the Parabat Express train from Dhaka Kamalapur. Enjoy rural scenic views of wetland paddy fields.
Arrive at Sreemangal Station. Check in at an eco-resort nestled amidst rubber and tea trees (e.g., Grand Sultan, Dusai, or Shanti Bari Eco Resort).
Lunch: Savor legendary Sylheti Shatkora Beef curry at Panshi or Kutum Bari.
Bicycle or easybike ride through the Finlay & BTRI rolling green tea plantations.
Visit the famous Nilkantha Tea Cabin to taste the legendary 7-Layer Rainbow Tea.

days.title: Lawachara National Park Wildlife Safari & Monipuri Indigenous Village

schedule.activity: Early morning guided walking trek inside Lawachara National Park. Listen for the distinct call of the endangered Hoolock Gibbon and spot hornbills.
Breakfast of hot Puri and spiced tea at the forest edge.
Visit Madhabpur Lake, surrounded by terraced tea hillocks with blooming wild pink water lilies.
Explore the Monipuri tribal handloom village in Radhanagar. Witness intricate shawls and scarves woven by hand.
Evening drive to Sylhet city. Check in to Sylhet hotel.

days.title: Ratargul Freshwater Swamp Forest & Turquoise Lalakhal River

schedule.activity: Drive from Sylhet city to Ratargul Swamp Forest boat ghat.
Board a quiet wooden boat rowed by a local boatman. Glide between the submerged Koroch trees beneath the emerald green canopy.
Climb the Ratargul Forest Watchtower for a 360-degree view of the submerged wetland.
Traditional Sylheti lunch: Fresh river fish curry, fried shutki, and Akhni Pulao.
Boat cruise on Lalakhal River, famous for its vivid turquoise and emerald mineral-tinted water flowing down from the Cherrapunji hills.

days.title: Hazrat Shah Jalal Dargah, Bholaganj Sada Pathor & Return

schedule.activity: Visit the 700-year-old historic Dargah of Hazrat Shah Jalal. Observe the sacred pond catfish and historic architecture.
Excursion to Bholaganj Sada Pathor (White Stone) – where crystal-clear icy mountain rivers tumble over millions of smooth white pebbles right on the border.
Final shopping for Sylheti Manipuri shawls, pure cane furniture pieces, and fresh Orange Shatkora.
Board return evening train (Kalni Express / Upaban) or 40-minute domestic flight back to Dhaka.

packingChecklist: Insect repellent & anti-leech salt packet for Lawachara rainforest
Waterproof dry pouch for phones and cameras during boat rides
Quick-dry t-shirts and lightweight cotton pants
Hat, sunglasses, and high-SPF sunscreen for open boat cruises
Cash for roadside fruit stalls and tea garden purchases

title: 3 Days in Saint Martin's & Chera Dwip: Coral Island Getaway
subtitle: Clear blue waves, fresh BBQ snapper, cycling along coconut groves & living coral reefs
bestSeason: November to February (smooth calm sea crossing)

days.title: Teknaf Ship Cruise, Coconut Welcoming & West Beach Sunset

schedule.activity: Board the luxury sea cruise ship (Keari Sindbad or Bay Cruiser) at Teknaf Damdamia Ghat. Cruise along the Naf River into the open Bay of Bengal.
Disembark at Saint Martin's Island jetty. Walk or ride a traditional wooden van to your beach resort (e.g., Blue Marine, Music Eco Resort, Coral View).
Lunch: Steamed rice, Loitta fish fry, and famous spicy Shutki Bhorta.
Rent a beach bicycle. Cycle across coconut groves to the quieter Western Beach.
Select a fresh live sea fish (Rupchanda, Red Snapper, or Koral) right at the shore and watch it grilled over glowing charcoal coals with spicy coriander sauce.

days.title: Chera Dwip Coral Reef Expedition & Stargazing by the Tide

schedule.activity: Witness a glorious island sunrise with fisherman hauling in fresh morning nets.
Take a local engine trawler or speed boat to Chera Dwip – the southernmost coral outcrop of Bangladesh.
Wade in knee-deep crystal-clear turquoise waters and observe living brain coral colonies and colorful reef fish.
Return to main island for lunch: Giant sweet coastal coconut water (Dab) and fresh mud crab curry.
Relax on a hammock under coconut trees with the gentle ocean breeze.
Night beach stroll: On moonless nights, marvel at bioluminescent plankton glowing in the cresting waves.

days.title: Local Dry Fish Market, Ship Departure & Return

schedule.activity: Visit the vibrant local fisherman's market. Pick up premium sun-dried fish (Shutki) and roasted cashew nuts.
Final dip in the warm ocean waves. Check out from resort.
Arrive at the jetty. Board the return cruise ship back to the mainland.
Reach Teknaf, connect with your luxury return coach to Dhaka or Cox's Bazar.

packingChecklist: Water shoes or strap sandals with thick soles (coral rocks are sharp)
High SPF Reef-Safe Sunscreen and UV protection sunglasses
Snorkeling mask (if you want to see underwater coral and reef fish)
Plenty of cash (island ATMs frequently run out of notes)
Motion sickness tablets for sea ship transit if prone to nausea

title: 3 Days in Sundarbans: Mangrove Cruise & Tiger Safari
subtitle: Cruise the mysterious labyrinth of tidal rivers, spot spotted deer, crocodiles and elusive Bengal Tigers
bestSeason: November to February (cool weather & active wildlife on banks)

days.title: Boarding at Mongla, Karamjal Breeding Center & Sailing into Wild Waters

schedule.activity: Board the luxury motor cruise vessel at Mongla Port. Meet the ship captain, crew, and armed Forest Department escorts.
Breakfast served on the open observation deck while navigating down the Pasur River.
Disembark at Karamjal Eco-tourism center. Walk the wooden boardwalk, visit the saltwater crocodile breeding tanks, and observe the deer herd.
Buffet lunch on board featuring fresh Khulna freshwater prawns and steamed rice.
Anchor deep inside the mangrove forest near Harbaria Eco Park. Watch kingfishers and monkey troops from deck.
Dinner under the stars, accompanied by river breezes and sounds of nocturnal forest wildlife.

days.title: Kotka Wildlife Sanctuary, Silent Canoe Safari & Watchtower

schedule.activity: Silent wooden rowboat trip into narrow forest creeks before the engine starts. Spot mudskippers, otters, and drinking spotted deer in the early morning fog.
Hearty ship breakfast: Hot Parathas, omelettes, and pure Sundarbans wild honey.
Guided walking trail through Kotka forest with armed guards. Walk along Jamtola Beach – an untouched, isolated wild beach on the Bay of Bengal.
Lunch: Traditional spicy Chui Jhal beef and lentils.
Climb the Kotka Watchtower. Scan the vast grassy clearing for herds of spotted deer, wild boars, and fresh Royal Bengal Tiger pugmarks in the soft mud.

days.title: Kochikhali Creek Exploration & Return to Mongla Port

schedule.activity: Early morning boat safari through Kochikhali canal. Spot Irrawaddy dolphins breaching the surface.
Breakfast and begin cruising back towards Mongla, enjoying the changing river delta vistas.
Farewell lunch on board with Hilsha fish curry and sweet curd.
Disembark at Mongla Tourism Ghat. Connect to your evening coach back to Dhaka via the Padma Bridge.

packingChecklist: Earthy/neutral colored clothing (green, beige, brown; avoid bright neon colors that startle animals)
Binoculars (essential for birdwatching and spotting distant wildlife)
Telephoto camera lens or smartphone zoom lens
Hat, sunglasses, and windbreaker for breezy deck viewing
Motion sickness medication if sensitive to river vessel movement
